description:

Your voice matters. Sign up today and help move Suffolk County forward.

title: Building Community Rally
description:

Our goal is to Build Community together. This isn't a protest, but a march for democracy and protecting the rights of our people. We want to facilitate and strengthen bonds because we are stronger together. A united Brazoria County is a STRONGER Brazoria County. 

After meeting at Veteran's Park (115 E. Magnolia St), we plan to make the short march around the block, with our route passing by the office of our local State Representative. We will have QR codes/zines with information and chants at both the park and courthouse. 

First Aid volunteers will be on site, and voter registration will be available. 

Confirmed speakers include: 
-Iowa Colony Councilwoman and Mayor Pro Tem Marquette Greene-Scott
-Activist and CD-14 Democratic Candidate Rhonda Hart

More Speakers have been invited, and this list will be updated when appropriate.

However Elon Musk is wrecking our government without authorization or justification. We know the power of our wallets, and #BoycottTesla movement was born. 

Don't buy new Tesla automobile. Divest from Tesla Stock. Their value is tanking thanks to investors who joined the movement. 

We urge the public to boycott Tesla to impact Elon Musk’s ability to continue his destructive and unconstitutional actions against our government, our country and its people. Help remind folks that they, too, can stand up for their beliefs - and that there's lots and lots of people who aren't on board with the "cruelty as entertainment" behavior of Trump and Musk and the GOP.

A Department of Transportation employee has visited twice in the past three weeks prior to 5/20 to ask that people NOT attach anything to the fencing. On 5/20, he parked and waited until everything was removed from the fencing. It seems reasonable to expect that DOT enforcement will continue.

The address "9 Mountain Park Rd, Holyoke" will get you there if you're using Waze. (Mountain Park Road runs off Route 5, and is not accessible from I-91.) People have reported that some GPS systems bring you right under the bridge, but on I-91. That’s annoying!

We've found that roof rake sections make wonderful flagpoles and banner poles. If you have a roof rake (or 10’-15’ light metal poles or conduit) to contribute, we'll be happy to take it off your hands!

Not open to press.

title: NO KINGS Erie
description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
Check out nokings.org for more information.

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*
